text:
Sara M: Heads up — planning a small CTA experiment across X + LinkedIn for the feature launch. Need final assets + copy and a posting cadence by EOD Wed.
Jordan PM: Timeline looks tight. Is Wed EOD a hard cutoff or can we slide to Thu morning?
Sara M: Wed EOD preferred so growth can queue automations.
Leo_growth: Proposed split: Variant A = 'Get a demo', Variant B = 'Register for webinar', Variant C = 'Start free trial'. Track clicks -> demo signups -> qualified leads. Pin best performer on X for 24h.
Mia_design: Got it. I can do 3 hero images + 2 short vids. Which aspect ratios you want for LI vs X?
Sara M: LinkedIn: 1200x628 for feed. X: 16:9 for timeline posts, 1:1 for promo cards.
Jordan PM: Also need UTM scheme. Use: `utm_campaign=featureX_launch&utm_source={platform}&utm_medium=social&utm_content={variant}` — include variant token a|b|c and asset id.
Leo_growth: I'll bake that into the scheduler. Will also map events in GA + Mixpanel: social_click, landing_submit, demo_booking.
Mia_design: ETA: images by Wed 1pm, videos by Thu morning. Can we prioritize image variants for scheduling?
Ops: Noted — posting window available Thu 09:00-11:00 PST and Thu 15:00-17:00 CET. We can reserve two high-visibility slots.
Sara M: Who owns inbound lead routing for webinar CTA? Want webinar leads routed to growth-sdr queue with tag `webinar_featureX`.
Jordan PM: I'll update routing rules today. Follow-up sequence proposed: 0h email (automated confirmation), 24h outreach from AE on LinkedIn, 3-day nurture drip. Thoughts?
Leo_growth: Benchmark targets: CTR baseline 1.2%, demo conversion 6%. If any variant lifts CTR by +20% and conversion by +10% let's push it into the rotation and increase budget.
Mia_design: Quick microcopy question — 'Get a demo' vs 'See it live' — keep it short. Which reads better for LI audience?
Jordan PM: Test both as sub-variants under demo CTA (A1/A2). Keep copy length < 60 chars for X.
Sara M: Please add copy + variant mapping to the scheduling sheet. Link (draft): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/featureX-cta (internal).
Leo_growth: I'll drop a UTM template row and the expected event mapping table in the sheet. Also will add the conversion benchmark and tracking dashboard link.
Sam_SDR: If leads come in with enterprise tags I'll take first pass — ping me and I'll prioritize outreach.
Ops: I'll confirm automation cron and ensure the scheduler respects platform rate limits.
Sara M: Great. Action items: Mia — deliver images by Wed 1pm. Jordan — update routing + copy variants sheet. Leo — set up UTM & dashboard. Ops — reserve posting slots and confirm automation. Sam — standby for enterprise leads. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled: 1) asset check Wed 13:00, 2) final schedule review Wed 17:00.
